news.subject: Choir News
news.html:
Hello BBC Choir!

NEW SEAT IDEA for Chapel Rehearsals

Since the chairs in the chapel are back to in their original order, I have a better plan for seating for our regular rehearsals and when the teens join us.  I'll share this with you next Sunday night.

COMING SOON - Practice tracks for "Jesus Is The Answer"

Even though the choir mainly sings on the choruses for this song, I've had a few people ask for practice tracks.  This will definitely help for the tricky sections of the songs that we discovered at last night's practice.  I will send practice tracks soon.

Thank you for your faithfulness!

David
